What is Apollo Group TV?

Apollo Group TV is a premium streaming service built for people who are tired of missing games, shows, and moments. It gives you instant access to live TV, sports, movies, and series in HD & 4K—without contracts or cable headaches.
Is Apollo Group TV available in Canada?
Yes. Apollo Group TV Canada is designed specifically for Canadian viewers, delivering smooth, reliable streaming nationwide.
What makes Apollo Group TV different from regular TV?
No contracts. No hardware rentals. No overpriced bundles. Just instant access to the content you actually want—when you want it.
What kind of content do I get?
Live TV, sports, news, movies, and TV series, plus a massive on-demand library so you're never stuck wondering what to watch.
Can I watch on all my devices?
Yes. Watch on your Smart TV, phone, tablet, laptop, or desktop. Start in one room, finish in another—no interruptions.
How many devices can I use?
You can stream on multiple devices depending on your plan, making it perfect for families or multi-device users.
Is there a contract or commitment?
No contracts. No lock-ins. You stay because you want to—not because you're forced to.
How fast do I get access after payment?
Most users are watching shortly after payment. No waiting days. No chasing support. You pay → you watch.
Do I need fast internet?
A stable internet connection is enough: HD streaming requires 10 Mbps+, and 4K streaming requires 25 Mbps+. That's it.
Does Apollo Group TV include sports?
Yes. Live sports coverage is included, so you don't miss big games, last-minute goals, or important moments.
Is setup complicated?
Not at all. Setup is simple and beginner-friendly. Most users are fully set up within minutes.
Can I watch while traveling?
Yes. Apollo Group TV lets you stay connected wherever you go—no matter the screen or location.
Are there hidden fees?
No surprises. No fine print tricks. Pricing is clear, transparent, and exactly what you see on the site.
How can I pay?
Payment is made by Interac e-Transfer. After you place your order by email or through the order form, we send you the payment instructions.
Is my payment information safe?
This website does not collect card details. Payment is sent by Interac e-Transfer through your own bank, so your banking details stay with your bank.
What happens when my subscription ends?
You simply renew if you want to continue. No automatic traps. No forced renewals. Full control stays with you.
Do you offer customer support?
Yes. Our support team is here to help with setup, access, and questions—because a premium service should feel premium.
Can I upgrade my plan later?
Absolutely. Upgrade anytime if you want more flexibility or extended access.
Who is Apollo Group TV for?
It's for people who want premium entertainment, freedom, and value—without paying cable prices or dealing with contracts.
How do I get started right now?
Choose your plan, complete payment, and start watching. The sooner you start, the sooner you stop missing out.
